subject: POC plan & final readout scheduling - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Hudson <alex.hudson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T16:15:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap & POC next steps

Hi Alex -

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can get the POC moving: 

Summary of needs:
- Evaluate latency and throughput for Acme's 3 main clinical NLP workloads (note ingestion size ~100k records/day)
- Verify on-prem/private deployment option for PHI workflows (VPC + KMS)
- Measure unit cost per 1k tokens with batching/kv-cache enabled

Proposed POC scope (4-week trial):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + environment setup (shared SFTP for sample data, SOC2 checklist)
2) Week 1-3: Run test suite (performance, accuracy vs baseline prompts)
3) Week 4: Final readout + exec decision (go/no-go)

Success criteria (proposal):
- Latency: median end-to-end < 300ms for 95% of queries in dev config
- Throughput: sustained 200 reqs/min on dedicated pool
- Quality: no more than 3% degradation vs baseline on clinical extraction prompts
- Ops: Private deployment validated with KMS integration and audit logs

Owners / asks:
- Acme: please confirm primary POC owner (we heard Priya might own evaluation) and provide sample dataset by 2026-08-09
- Redwood: Marcus will lead environment setup; Neha will run monitoring/quality checks; I will coordinate scheduling and commercial items

Attachments: POC plan (20260802-acme-poc-plan.pdf), requirements matrix (20260802-requirements.xlsx)
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAcmePOC

Suggested kickoff slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-08-10 09:00-10:00
- Wed 2026-08-11 11:00-12:00
- Thu 2026-08-12 14:00-15:00

If these look good I'll lock a time and send a calendar invite and kickoff agenda.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

Date: 2026-08-02T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & POC next steps

Thanks Marissa - really helpful recap. Priya (cc'd) will be the POC owner on our side. A few tweaks from our side: 

- Success criteria: please add a check for de-identification accuracy on PHI fields (we'd like > 98% recall on token masking)
- Timeline: 4 weeks is fine but can we aim to have the final readout week of Sep 7 so execs have time to review before Q3 budgeting closes?
- Data: we'll share a 1k-record sample (de-identified) by 2026-08-09. Full dataset access will require our security team's approval (I can expedite).

We'll plan to kick off week of Aug 10. Of your suggested slots, Wed 2026-08-11 11:00 PT works best for me.

Attaching our intake matrix with a few more environment constraints.

Alex
Director of Data Systems | Acme Health
alex.hudson@acmehealth.com

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & POC next steps

Perfect - thanks Alex and Priya. Wed Aug 11 11:00 PT is booked. I'll send a calendar invite with the kickoff agenda (30-45 min).

Notes for the internal team (Marcus / Neha):
- Marcus: plan for a private deployment proof-of-concept on a small dedicated pool (we'll use quantized weights for cost parity). I'll share the sample dataset once Acme confirms.
- Neha: design the monitoring dashboard (latency, token cost, quality metrics) and the eval harness for the clinical extraction prompts.
- Commercial: I intend to hold on contractual/commitment discussions until after the final readout, but we should prepare a standard Dedicated proposal (estimate attached) so we can move quickly post-go/no-go.

Marcus & Neha - can you both confirm availability for Aug 11 kickoff and who will own the week-by-week tasks?

Thanks -
Marissa

All good from my side - I'm available for the Aug 11 kickoff. I'll own environment setup and bring a short runbook to the kickoff (network reqs, KMS config, sample infra).

High-level week breakdown I'm proposing: 
- Week 0 (Aug 11-13): env prep + data ingest (Marcus)
- Week 1 (Aug 14-20): baseline runs + early tuning (Marcus)
- Week 2 (Aug 21-27): scale tests + monitoring (Neha)
- Week 3 (Aug 28-Sep 3): final validation + readout prep (Marissa/Neha)

I'll also prepare a checklist for Acme's security team (SOC2 artifacts, network allowlist) to speed approvals.

Subject: Re: POC plan & final readout scheduling

Thanks everyone - confirm kickoff Aug 11 11:00 PT. Priya and I will provide the 1k de-identified sample by Aug 9. Our security lead will review the checklist; happy to join any prep calls with Marcus.

One more ask on the decision process: our exec review is tentatively scheduled for Sep 10. We will expect the final readout to include: a one-page exec summary, key metrics vs success criteria, risk blockers, and a recommended contract path (dedicated vs hosted, estimated MRR). If you can provide a doc we can circulate to execs a couple days before the meeting that would be ideal. 

If the readout is positive we'll want a commercial term sheet and draft DocuSign by Sep 14 so procurement can move quickly.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Alex
